text:
Amanda (PM): ok team — planning thread for the next quarter slice for Hosted API. goal: pick 2-3 focused launches across chat/completions/embeddings/rerank that move latency/cost and customer adoption metrics. quick takebacks pls.

Devin (Eng): +1. I'd prioritize an embeddings latency/cost improvement and a lightweight rerank endpoint. both lowish infra risk.

Sam (Product): agree on embeddings + rerank. embeddings has obvious adoption by search customers; rerank is highest revenue upside for enterprise.

Lina (Research): for embeddings we should decide: a) smaller dimension default (e.g., 768) vs b) compressed 1024 with quantized op. both affect quality — need eval sets. I can run quality vs latency tradeoffs if we lock the eval suites.

Raj (SRE): ops checklist: can we hit p95 < 120ms for embeddings (single-vector) on hosted? if not we need cache tier or dedicated pools. rerank has batch/pipeline implications — plan for async fallback.

Devin (Eng): technical notes:
- embeddings: we can introduce a cost-opt mode that picks a 16-bit quantized runtime + prefix cache. quick perf wins with ~2–2.5x throughput.
- rerank: two modes — streaming topk (fast, rough score) and full cross-attention (slower, accurate). we should ship streaming first.

Maria (Design): UX ask: add response metadata for embeddings (model, vector-dim, quantized=true) so customers can make informed decisions. rerank results should include provenance + trace id.

Sam (Product): success metrics proposals:
- embeddings: 30% median latency reduction for single-vector calls, 25% cost/unit reduction, +15% adoption in search customers within 60d.
- rerank: enable 2x throughput for topk streaming; pilot with 3 enterprise customers; target 99.5% availability for the endpoint.

Lina (Research): we'll need canonical eval sets: semantic-search-synth (1k queries), bench-retrieval-100 (customer anonymized), and rerank-pairs (5000 pairs). I can own that.

Devin (Eng): rough timeline: 6 wks for embeddings cost-mode prototype (bench + canary), 8–10 wks for streaming-rerank alpha. deps: infra kernel updates + runtime batching tweaks.

Raj (SRE): canary plan: 5% traffic on hosted first, route-by-customer opt-in, automatic rollback on error-rate spike or latency > target for 5min. need release engineering slot.

release-bot: New deployment window reserved: 2026-05-04 02:00 UTC — please add release checklist items to the release board.

Amanda (PM): tradeoffs: if embedding quantized mode degrades quality by >3% on bench, we keep it opt-in only. for rerank streaming, if topk accuracy is <80% of full cross-attention we add a hybrid mode.

Sam (Product): customers to loop in for pilots: Acme Search (embeddings), DeepDocs (rerank), Nova Retail (embeddings + rerank). I'll start outreach.

Maria (Design): quick API surface suggestion for embeddings: POST /v1/embeddings?mode=cost_optimized and embed metadata header. small change but helps adoption.

Devin (Eng): ops note: implement per-customer routing policies so pilot customers hit Dedicated pools if they need SLA. that's a medium scope infra task but worth it.

Lina (Research): will produce initial eval report in 10 days if I get samples from Sam.

Raj (SRE): I'll draft SLOs we need for launch + runbook items. target to share by EOW.

Amanda (PM): action items summary:
- Lina: assemble eval sets (10d)
- Devin: embeddings prototype + perf run (6w)
- Devin/Raj: canary + routing plan (2w)
- Sam: customer pilot outreach (this week)
- Maria: API metadata proposal (3d)
- Raj: SLOs & runbook (EOW)

Amanda (PM): blockers? callouts? otherwise I'll convert this to a PRD stub and link it to the Q2 roadmap doc.

Devin (Eng): minor blocker: kernel vendor update may take calendar week to land. flagging.

Sam (Product): no blockers from my side. will send pilot invites today.

Maria (Design): will upload API mockups to figma tomorrow.

Lina (Research): requesting anonymized sample docs from Acme & Nova for better evals. Sam can you coordinate?

Amanda (PM): noted. thanks all — follow-up check-in Thurs 11am PT.

Raj (SRE): ack.

release-bot: Reminder: add the PRD to the product board before scheduling the release window.
